a4MasterCryo.label: After a party Cryo reaction
a4MasterCryo.reason: The ATK bonus starts only after another party member triggers a Cryo reaction while he is in Masterstroke mode.

c6BurstMaster.label: Constellation 6 Burst crits
c6BurstMaster.reason: A Constellation 6 crit bonus for a Burst unleashed in Masterstroke mode, which depends on when the player casts it.

willConsumed.label: Will to Win spent
willConsumed.reason: Will to Win builds up from the damage party members deal while he is in Masterstroke mode, so the amount depends on the team.
